characters.description: The Dragon Reborn and Car'a'carn, hardened and increasingly isolated, ruling many nations and commanding both the Aiel and a growing corps of Asha'man, with Aes Sedai now sworn to him. Driving grimly toward the Last Battle, he wrestles with the taint's slow madness, trusts almost no one, and means to hunt down the Forsaken one by one.
characters.name: Rand al'Thor

characters.description: Rand's luck-blessed friend, a brilliant reluctant general carrying dead men's memories of war, a Power-turning medallion, and a black-hafted spear. Sent on the Dragon's errands, he grumbles at every turn while proving uncannily good at surviving, and at winning, the trouble fate keeps handing him.
characters.name: Mat Cauthon

characters.description: Rand's steady friend, a wolfbrother and lord of the Two Rivers, wed to Faile and serving at the Dragon's side. Deliberate and loyal, he grows uneasy at how cold and dangerous Rand has become, and torn between duty to his friend and to his wife.
characters.name: Perrin Aybara

characters.description: The innkeeper's daughter of Emond's Field, raised Amyrlin Seat of the rebel Aes Sedai who oppose Elaida. Young in years but iron-willed and cunning, she is steadily out-maneuvering the older sisters who expected to rule through her, and bending them toward war on the usurped White Tower.
characters.name: Egwene al'Vere

characters.description: The former Wisdom of Emond's Field, a channeler of great strength and a gifted Healer, newly wed to Lan and finally learning to reach the Power without her old crutch of anger. Proud and headstrong, she throws herself into the search for a means to mend the broken weather.
characters.name: Nynaeve al'Meara

characters.description: The Daughter-Heir of Andor, a strong channeler working with Nynaeve and Aviendha in the city of Ebou Dar. Poised and dutiful, she pursues an ancient object of the Power while her thoughts turn toward claiming the throne of Andor that is hers by right.
characters.name: Elayne Trakand

characters.description: The uncrowned last king of a fallen Borderland realm and a matchless swordsman, now Warder and husband to Nynaeve. Grim and devoted, he guards her through the dangers of a strange southern city, his fatalism tempered a little by an unexpected marriage.
characters.name: Lan

characters.description: A blunt young woman who foresees the future in images only she can see, now constantly at Rand's side as one of the very few he wholly trusts. Practical and warm beneath a sharp tongue, she has grown close and dear to the Dragon Reborn.
characters.name: Min

characters.description: An Aiel woman training to be a Wise One and a channeler, proud, blunt, and bound by strict honor. Deeply entangled with Rand and with the wetlander customs she still finds baffling, she works alongside Elayne and Nynaeve on their urgent errand.
characters.name: Aviendha

characters.description: A legendary Aes Sedai of fearsome reputation and great age, long thought retired, who reappears with designs of her own concerning the Dragon Reborn and the young men who channel. Blunt, imperious, and cleverer than nearly anyone around her, she is accustomed to bending others to her will without apology.
characters.name: Cadsuane

characters.description: One of the Forsaken, the Dark One's ancient champions, a proud and ruthless war-captain who has seized rule of the nation of Illian under a false name. Jealous of standing among his own kind and contemptuous of the upstart Dragon Reborn, he schemes against Rand from his stronghold.
characters.name: Sammael
